exampleKo: 어젯밤에 우리 집에서 귀신을 봤어.
exampleEn: I saw a ghost at my house last night.

exampleKo: 여기 유령이 나온다는 소문이 있어.
exampleEn: There is a rumor that a phantom appears here.

exampleKo: 옛날 옛적에 도깨비가 살았대.
exampleEn: They say a goblin used to live here a long time ago.

exampleKo: 달빛 아래서 구미호의 꼬리가 보였어.
exampleEn: I saw the tails of a nine-tailed fox under the moonlight.

exampleKo: 꿈에 검은 옷을 입은 저승사자가 나타났어.
exampleEn: A grim reaper dressed in black appeared in my dream.

meaningEn: the ghost of an unmarried woman
exampleKo: 머리를 풀어헤친 처녀귀신을 마주쳤어.
exampleEn: I ran into the ghost of an unmarried woman with loose hair.

exampleKo: 깊은 호수에는 물귀신이 산다는 이야기가 있어.
exampleEn: There is a story that a water ghost lives in the deep lake.

exampleKo: 한이 맺힌 원귀가 떠돌고 있나 봐.
exampleEn: It seems a vengeful spirit full of grudges is wandering around.

exampleKo: 하얀 소복을 입은 형체가 다가왔어.
exampleEn: A figure wearing a white mourning dress approached.

exampleKo: 마을 사람들은 무당을 찾아가서 물어봤어.
exampleEn: The villagers went to visit a shaman and asked about it.

exampleKo: 집안의 평안을 위해 큰 굿을 했대.
exampleEn: They held a big shamanic ritual for the peace of the family.

exampleKo: 문 앞에 붉은색 부적을 붙여두었어.
exampleEn: I posted a red paper talisman in front of the door.

meaningEn: becoming a shaman through spirit possession
exampleKo: 그 친구가 갑자기 신내림을 받았대.
exampleEn: I heard that friend suddenly became a shaman through spirit possession.

exampleKo: 새해 운세를 보러 점집에 다녀왔어.
exampleEn: I went to a fortune teller's place to check my fortune for the new year.

exampleKo: 올해는 액운을 쫓아내고 싶어.
exampleEn: I want to ward off bad luck this year.

exampleKo: 액땜 셈치고 좋은 일이라 생각하자.
exampleEn: Let's think of it as warding off bad luck and take it positively.

exampleKo: 그 오래된 인형에는 무서운 저주가 걸려 있어.
exampleEn: A scary curse is placed on that old doll.

exampleKo: 그 이야기를 들었을 때 정말 오싹했어.
exampleEn: I felt a real sudden chill when I heard that story.

exampleKo: 그 얘기를 듣자마자 소름 돋았어.
exampleEn: I got goosebumps the moment I heard that story.

exampleKo: 밤에 찾아간 빈집은 분위기가 으스스했어.
exampleEn: The atmosphere of the abandoned house we visited at night was eerie.

meaningEn: to feel a chill down one's spine
exampleKo: 이상한 소리가 들려서 등골이 서늘해졌어.
exampleEn: I heard a strange sound and felt a chill run down my spine.

meaningEn: to be scared out of one's wits
exampleKo: 갑자기 튀어나온 형체 때문에 간담이 서늘했어.
exampleEn: I was scared out of my wits because of the figure that suddenly popped out.

meaningEn: to be too frightened to move
exampleKo: 너무 무서워서 오금이 저려 움직일 수가 없었어.
exampleEn: I was too frightened to move because my knees went weak with fear.

exampleKo: 어젯밤에 가위눌려서 한참 못 움직였어.
exampleEn: I was sleep-paralyzed last night and could not move for a while.

exampleKo: 무서운 꿈을 꾸고 나서 식은땀을 흘렸어.
exampleEn: I broke out in a cold sweat after having a scary dream.

exampleKo: 갑자기 소리가 나서 심장이 철렁했어요.
exampleEn: My heart dropped because of the sudden noise.

exampleKo: 그 이야기를 들으니 머리카락이 쭈뼛 섰어요.
exampleEn: My hair stood on end when I heard that story.

meaningEn: to get scared, to lose one's nerve
exampleKo: 동생이 겁먹은 얼굴로 내 손을 잡았어요.
exampleEn: My younger sibling grabbed my hand with a frightened face.

meaningEn: to be startled out of one's skin
exampleKo: 창문 밖의 거대한 그림자를 보고 기겁했어요.
exampleEn: I jumped in fright seeing the huge shadow outside the window.

exampleKo: 마을 끝에 있는 폐가에 불이 켜졌어요.
exampleEn: A light turned on in the abandoned house at the edge of the village.

exampleKo: 여기는 밤마다 귀신이 나온다는 흉가예요.
exampleEn: This is a cursed house where ghosts are said to appear every night.

exampleKo: 달빛 아래 공동묘지는 정말 으스스했어요.
exampleEn: The public graveyard under the moonlight was really spooky.

exampleKo: 옛날 무덤 근처를 지나갈 때 조용히 걸었어요.
exampleEn: We walked quietly when passing near the old burial mound.

exampleKo: 옛날 사람들은 죽으면 저승으로 간다고 믿었어요.
exampleEn: People long ago believed that you go to the afterlife when you die.

meaningEn: this world, the world of the living
exampleKo: 귀신이 아직 이승을 떠나지 못했다고 해요.
exampleEn: They say the ghost hasn't been able to leave this world yet.

exampleKo: 골목길이 너무 으슥해서 발걸음을 빨리했어요.
exampleEn: The alleyway was so dark and unnerving that I quickened my pace.

exampleKo: 오늘 밤에는 둥근 보름달이 떠서 더 밝아요.
exampleEn: Tonight is even brighter because a round full moon is out.

exampleKo: 놀이공원에서 귀신의 집에 들어가 소리쳤어요.
exampleEn: I screamed after going into the haunted house at the amusement park.

meaningEn: a scary story, an urban legend
exampleKo: 친구들과 모여서 재미있는 괴담을 나눴어요.
exampleEn: We gathered with friends and shared interesting scary stories.

exampleKo: 엘리베이터 거울에 관한 도시전설을 들었어요.
exampleEn: I heard an urban legend about the elevator mirror.

exampleKo: 늦은 밤 음악실에 얽힌 학교괴담을 속삭였어요.
exampleEn: We whispered about the school ghost story tied to the late-night music room.

exampleKo: 여름 밤마다 TV에서 하는 납량특집을 즐겨 봐요.
exampleEn: I enjoy watching the summer horror specials on TV every summer night.

exampleKo: 수련회 밤에 어두운 산길로 담력 시험을 갔어요.
exampleEn: We went on a test of courage down a dark mountain path on the retreat night.

exampleKo: 불을 끄고 무서운 공포영화를 같이 봤어요.
exampleEn: We turned off the lights and watched a scary horror film together.

meaningEn: to be possessed by a ghost
exampleKo: 오래된 인형에 귀신 들렸다는 소문이 돌았어요.
exampleEn: Rumors spread that the old doll was possessed by a ghost.

exampleKo: 할로윈 축제에 재미있는 옷을 입고 나갔어요.
exampleEn: I went out in a fun outfit for the Halloween festival.

meaningEn: to dress up in costume and makeup
exampleKo: 파티를 위해서 멋지게 뱀파이어로 분장했어요.
exampleEn: I dressed up nicely as a vampire for the party.

exampleKo: 마녀 코스튬을 입고 거리를 돌아다녔어요.
exampleEn: I walked around the streets wearing a witch costume.

exampleKo: 현관 앞에 무서운 표정의 호박등을 켰어요.
exampleEn: I turned on a jack-o'-lantern with a scary expression in front of the porch.

exampleKo: 이웃 집에서 달콤한 사탕을 많이 받았어요.
exampleEn: I received a lot of sweet candy from the neighbor's house.
